evaluation.summary: A strong, honest CV: every claim traces to the CV, portfolio or notes, with notes facts (AWS certification, Snowflake cost saving, on-call, talk, teaching) well used and metrics kept intact. ATS text is clean and well sectioned, missing only some searchable wording such as 'CI/CD' and 'data modelling'. The cover letter is accurate and handles the Google Cloud gap honestly but is role-generic, ignoring Halden Pay's payments domain and values and lacking a proper letter header. Work arrangement is kept neutral, and layout is clean with minor wrapping and white space.
